info.title: Canon record API
info.description: REST access to a Canon workspace's records (docs/record-api.md). This document covers the standard objects as an admin sees them; GET /api/v1/openapi.json gives a workspace's own, with its custom objects and fields. `x-stability` is `stable` for what docs/record-api.md documents and `preview` for what may still change; `x-canon-undescribed` marks a part not described yet.

filter.name: filter
filter.description: `field:op:value`, repeated to combine with AND. A list value (`in`, `hasAny`, `hasAll`) is comma-separated; `empty` and `notEmpty` take no value. Number, currency and checkbox fields take a number or true/false.

bucket.name: bucket
bucket.description: How a date groups; `month` by default. Date-times bucket by UTC day.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests a minute in the tightest budget that applies: the token's or the workspace's, for this kind of request

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in that budget this window

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until that budget's window resets

bearer.description: A paired CLI token (`fsgtm_...`, from `canon login`) or a Clerk session JWT. Every call runs as that user, in that user's workspace.

exportKey.description: An export key (`cwx_...`) from Settings, Workspace

importKey.description: An import key (`cwi_...`) from Settings, Workspace
